title: Raft 論文閱讀批註 / Reading notes

source.label: raft-paper.md §5
lines: 提交條件 depends on a majority acknowledgement.
Safety requires the entry to be from the current term.
Clients may retry after a timeout.
同一 command 必須去重，避免重複套用。
The response includes the committed index.

annotations.body: 多數派確認不是唯一條件；current term 仍是 safety 關鍵。
Retry 與 command ID 如何共同保證 exactly-once effect？
此單行範圍嵌套在 a-majority；輸出仍保留輸入順序。
